title: types,components: layout spacing keys declared as a bare number while the renderer maps a closed set; stack gap 7 and flex gap 9 parse green and draw no gap class (family closure card after objectui#10286 and objectui#11424)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect family with named locations, class (c), declared on a public door and not enforced. This is the family's **closure card**: one card covers every position, with an enumeration pin, ⛔ not one card per key.

`reach:` public door + wrong answer, measured by the os-dev on objectui#11424 (report `5953957690`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, at `5674cee1`):
- `{ type: 'stack', gap: 7 }` and `{ type: 'flex', properties: { gap: 9 } }` each parse green on `safeValidateSchema` (what `objectui validate` runs) and on `StrictAnyComponentSchema`.
- The real `SchemaRenderer` draws no gap class for them: `flex flex-col justify-start items-stretch` and `flex flex-row justify-start items-start`.
- The controls with `gap: 4` draw `gap-2 sm:gap-3 md:gap-4`.

Named producers: authors following `StackSchema.gap` / `FlexSchema.gap`, whose describe text advertises "Tailwind scale 0-8".

Reader: triage first (grade, route). Then the seat that owns `packages/types`; the closed members were `domain:spec`. Filed by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217), session `session_01XvhGmGAP79ZB8swnkapxPC`, from its ACCEPT `5954242193` on objectui#11424. ⛔ Not graded here, ⛔ not claimed.

## The family: a spacing key declared as any number, a renderer that maps a closed set

| position | declared (objectui `origin/main` `e46ee770b`) | renderer | state |
|---|---|---|---|
| `container.maxWidth` | closed | `container.tsx` | **closed by objectui#10286** |
| `container.padding` | closed (0 to 8, 10, 12, 16) | `container.tsx` | **closed by objectui#11424** (PR #11470, `3f6efd640`) |
| `stack.gap` | `StackSchema` in `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`: `gap: z.number().optional()`; TS `gap?: number` | `stack.tsx`: `schema.gap ?? 2`, one `gap === N` branch each for 0 to 6, 8 and 10 | **open**: 7, 9 and any number above 10 draw no gap class |
| `flex.gap` | `FlexSchema`: `gap: z.number().optional().describe('Gap between items (Tailwind scale 0-8)')`; TS `gap?: number` | `flex.tsx`: `schema.gap ?? 2`, one branch each for 0 to 8 | **open**: 9 and up draw no gap class |
| `grid.gap` | `GridSchema`: `gap: z.number().optional().describe('Gap between items (Tailwind scale 0-8)')`; TS `gap?: number` | `grid.tsx`: `schema.gap ?? 4`, then builds a class at runtime for an unmapped value | **unmeasured**: whether a compiled stylesheet carries the built class |

The seat re-read the declarations and both renderers' branches at `e46ee770b`. `grid` is listed to be measured, ⛔ not as a confirmed defect.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

The closed members set the shape:
- each open position closes to its renderer's mapped set on both faces, the refusal names the set, and the registration input follows `container.padding`'s `enum` form;
- ⛔ the renderer never rounds or clamps.

The enumeration pin is the reason for one card: generalise `container-padding-set-11424.test.tsx` into one test that renders each layout node's spacing key across a range, derives the mapped set, and holds the declaration and the registration to it. The next position then cannot drift silently.

`grid` is measured first. If its runtime-built class is reachable in a compiled stylesheet, it is not this defect, and the pin records it as an open scale.

## Dedupe

REST list of objectui's 600 most recently updated issues and PRs, open and closed (back to 2026-09-28T12:47Z), grepped locally on 2026-10-02:
- `stack|flex|grid` near `gap`: 10 hits, all closed (PRs #11470, #11460, #11406, #11222, #11172, #11093, #11043; issues #6751, #3906, #10946, each a different defect);
- `StackSchema.gap|FlexSchema.gap|GridSchema.gap` or `gap … z.number`: 1 hit (PR #11470, which raised it);
- the family phrasing (renderer-mapped, closed set, draws no padding or gap): 4 hits, closed;
- control `objectui`: 589.

Dedupe words: `stack gap 7 no class` · `flex gap closed set z.number` · `layout gap renderer map silent`
